research.edition: international API-SPORTS Football API v3 at v3.football.api-sports.io
research.searchCoverage: Official Football v3 REST API is GET https://v3.football.api-sports.io/{path} with x-apisports-key. GET /timezone is the pinned credential validator and is used as healthcheck rather than predictions/search. GET /leagues, GET /teams, GET /standings, and GET /players/squads are documented reads. Official docs say only x-apisports-key is an allowed request header; native omits Accept and the upstream user-agent. HTTP 200 bodies with a populated errors array/object are demoted via bodyErrorPaths. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found no qualifying API-SPORTS platform compromise. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to documented GET /timezone, matching the pinned credential validator, rather than predictions or fixture search. timezone is not a named upstream action, so the mapping reuses football_list_leagues.
Official docs say only x-apisports-key is allowed; native omits Accept and the upstream user-agent.
HTTP 200 bodies with a populated errors array or object are treated as failures via bodyErrorPaths [errors]. Empty errors []/{} are success.
Native category is utility rather than Data: Rust CATEGORIES has no data or sports bucket.
Returns raw API-SPORTS JSON under data rather than the upstream mapped wrappers.
Calls documented GET /leagues with optional scalar filters. Array/fanout filters are omitted.
Returns raw API-SPORTS JSON under data rather than the upstream {leagues,pagination} mapping.
Official GET /teams requires at least one parameter. Native requires league and season, the documented league-season listing, and omits id/name/country/code/venue/search anyOf fanout.
Returns raw API-SPORTS JSON under data rather than the upstream {teams,pagination} mapping.
Calls documented GET /standings with required league and season. Optional team-only standings from the source anyOf are omitted so the native path stays a single league table.
Returns raw API-SPORTS JSON under data rather than the upstream {league,tables} mapping.
Calls documented GET /players/squads with required team. Player-only squad lookups are omitted.
Returns raw API-SPORTS JSON under data rather than the upstream {squad} mapping.
